# TRL-AUTH-0006: Duplicate credential actor for target scope

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: AUTH
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Use one credential per actor, host, and target scope; do not pool tokens to multiply rate-limit throughput.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-AUTH-0006", "severity": "error", "params": {"host": "<host>", "targetScope": "<targetScope>"}}
```
